title: Lagu Buat Eyang
subject: a man learning an old keroncong song on a borrowed ukulele for six weeks to sing at his girlfriend's grandmother's eightieth birthday, so the family will take him seriously
caption: Indonesian 90s jazz-pop vocal group in the Kahitna revival style. A Fender Rhodes playing lush ninth and eleventh chords; a smooth fretless electric bass sliding between roots; a brushed jazz drum kit with soft rimshots and a light swing; muted trumpet fills between vocal phrases; stacked four-part male close-harmony backing vocals. Polished 1990s studio sheen, warm and round, harmonies spread wide, gentle plate reverb. Male voice, a smooth light tenor with relaxed jazzy phrasing, the group answering in close harmony. 96 BPM, E-flat major. Warm, smitten, gently teasing. No trap drums, no autotune, no rock guitar, no EDM synths, no rap verse.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords and muted trumpet]

[Verse 1]
Enam minggu lalu kamu bilang
Eyang ulang tahun yang kedelapan puluh
Beliau suka lagu keroncong lama
Aku pinjam ukulele tetangga kos

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiap malam aku latihan
Sampai jari merah dan tetangga protes

[Chorus]
Lagu buat Eyang, aku nyanyi pelan
Biar kunci salah, yang penting sungguhan
Lagu buat Eyang, buat kamu juga
Di depan keluargamu aku nggak lari

[Verse 2]
Malam itu rumah penuh sepupu
Om-om duduk sambil melirik tajam
Suaraku gemetar di baris pertama
Eyang pelan-pelan ikut bersenandung

[Pre-Chorus]
Di bait kedua satu ruangan nyanyi
Kamu senyum sambil tutup muka

[Chorus]
Lagu buat Eyang, aku nyanyi pelan
Eyang tepuk tanganku, bilang lumayan
Lagu buat Eyang, buat kamu juga
Minggu depan Om ajak aku mancing

[Outro - Rhodes and close harmony]
Ukulele tetangga, belum kubalikin
